title: Dhindora Season 2 premieres on Netflix on 20 November; Season 1 was on YouTube
headline: Dhindora 2 Moves From YouTube to Netflix on 20 Nov
caption:
Dhindora, Bhuvan Bam's comedy drama, returns for Season 2 on Friday, 20 November, only on Netflix. Season 1 ran free on his BB Ki Vines YouTube channel from October 2021; Netflix now streams that season as well.

This time, Titu Mama is reeling from an ₹11 crore loss, and his attempt to make peace with his in-laws lands him in bigger trouble. Bam again plays the whole family, including Titu Mama, Babloo ji, Janki, Sameer and Bancho. Sanjeeda Sheikh joins as Kavita Mami, Titu Mama's wife. Sneha Shetty Kohli directs, her first time as a director.

Netflix India's trailer, posted on 13 November, had over 88 lakh views on YouTube by Tuesday morning.

Which Bhuvan Bam character did you grow up on?

Sources: Netflix, Republic World, Bollywood Hungama, Fossbytes
